# SchoolOye

> SchoolOye is a school-discovery and admissions-information directory for India, currently covering Jaipur, Rajasthan. Every school has its own entity page with board affiliation, grades, fees (where published), admission dates, and verified contact details.

Each school's canonical page is also available as clean markdown at its own URL with `/index.md` appended (e.g. `/en/jaipur/some-school-110636/index.md`) — use that for machine reading instead of parsing the HTML page.

## Key pages
- `/en/jaipur` — every published school in the launch city
- `/en/compare` — side-by-side facts for up to 4 schools
- `/en/tools/age-eligibility` — age eligibility checker

## Notes for AI crawlers
- Facts are sourced from official board records and each school's own published notices, with a source and last-verified date shown on the page. Unknown values are shown as "Not yet published" — never guessed or interpolated.
- No paid ranking and no star ratings exist on this site; any "Sponsored" label is always visible.
